$schema_note: Consumed by src/scripts/check_review_prompt_binding.ts. An entry EXEMPTS one committed review prompt from the sha256(prompt.md) == prompt_hash check. Both hashes are pinned on purpose: if either moves, the entry stops matching and the gate reds, so a later repair and a further corruption are equally visible. A pre-loaded verdict is NEVER suppressed by the hash exemption alone — it needs its own `steered_ack` block on the entry, which pins the exact matched phrase, so growth of the shared steering predicate cannot turn committed prompts into permanent unfixable blocks and cannot be waved through silently either.

entries.reason: Explained and closed at the cause: the archival sweep rewrote a roadmap path INSIDE this committed reviewer prompt while migrating inbound references. The cause was fixed on 2026-08-11 by _FROZEN_RECORD_PREFIXES in the sweep. Not repaired because repair is not available here: the recorded hash was produced by the ORIGINAL prompt text, so rewriting the hash to match the corrupted text would fabricate a binding that never existed, and restoring the text from history would erase the only evidence that the sweep reached inside a committed round at all. An earlier revision of this entry cited section 2.7 as forbidding the edit; that citation was wrong and is corrected here, because section 2.7 says the rename is an archival step and never an edit ban on a live artefact.
